flow.label: Your name
Your email
flow.help: We send updates about your account to this address.

flow.label: Best phone number for business
Company name
Company website

none_option.label: We do not have a website yet

flow.label: Who else on your team should we talk to?
flow.help: Name, job title and email for each person. Put each person on a new line.
flow.placeholder: e.g. Alex Kim, Head of Sales, alex@example.com

flow.label: Which platform is your store on?
Your best-selling products
flow.help: Names or links. Tell us which ones you want to sell more of.

flow.label: Who buys from you?
flow.help: Age, interests, why they buy, and what makes them come back.

flow.label: How does your brand talk?
flow.help: For example: warm and funny, or calm and expert. Links to emails or posts you like help a lot.

flow.label: What messages or offers have worked best for you?
Who are your main competitors?
Your active discount codes, and when to use them
Link to your Facebook page or your ads
Roughly how many people are on your email list?
Do you want SMS as well as email?
Do you have a Klaviyo account?
options: No, please set one up for us

flow.label: Invite us to your Klaviyo account as an Admin user
flow.help: In Klaviyo: Settings, then Users, then Add new user. Use the email address in our welcome message.

flow.label: Add us as a staff member in your store
flow.help: This lets us add sign-up forms and check the sending domain.

flow.label: Is your sending domain set up in Klaviyo?
Is there any access you cannot give us yet?
flow.help: Tell us what it is and why. For example, the login belongs to someone who is away. We will sort it out with you on the onboarding call.

flow.label: What would make the first 90 days a success for you?
flow.help: For example, a share of store sales from email, or a bigger list.

flow.label: Is there anything you are worried about?
flow.help: For example, something that went wrong with an agency before. We would rather know now.

flow.label: Anything else we should know before the onboarding call?

done.heading: That's everything. Thank you.
done.blurb: Your answers are in. We read them before your onboarding call, so the call starts with your business and not with questions you have already answered.

next.heading: What happens next
items: We read your answers and prepare for the onboarding call.
On the call we check Klaviyo access together and go through any answer you were not sure about.
Then we build your first flows, starting with the welcome and abandoned cart emails.

links.heading: Book your onboarding call
links.body: Choose a time that suits you.
